title: Ho-oh No.250 Japanese Neo Revelation Holo Rare Vintage Pokemon Card 2000
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokemon Japanese - Ho-oh (Houou), Holo Rare, No.250

Vintage Japanese Neo Revelation (Neo 3 / Awakening Legends) set, released 2000. Basic Pokemon, LV.45, HP90. Illustrated by Kimiya Masago.

Attacks: Flare Up (Pokemon Power), Sacred Fire, Sacred Wind (Godbird) - 90 damage
Weakness: Water, Resistance: Fighting -30

Ungraded, raw single. Condition: this is a genuinely vintage (25+ year old) card - please review all photos carefully, visible edge/corner wear consistent with age and handling. Front and back both photographed, judge corners, edges, surface and centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive.

Shipping: Penny sleeve into a top loader, inside a bubble mailer with cardboard backing. Combined shipping on multiple purchases - just ask before paying.
